id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

timestamp.description: The timestamp at which this validation run was executed.

rootRuleset.description: The root ruleset whose rules and all descendant rules were run.

subject.description: The {@link DataValidationSubject} this run is associated with. If not set, the run is one per ruleset, rather than one per subject.

args.description: The args passed into each rule function.

results.description:
The results generated by this run that are not persisted.
Please use {DataValidationRun#getResults} to get the results from a run.

persistedResults.description:
The results found by this run that are persisted.
Please use {DataValidationRun#getResults} to get the results from a run.

rulesetResults.description:
The ruleset results found by this run that are not persisted.
Please use {DataValidationRun#getRulesetResults} to get the results from a run.

persistedRulesetResults.description:
The ruleset results found by this run that are persisted.
Please use {DataValidationRun#getRulesetResults} to get the results from a run.

numViolations.description: Number of data violations found by this run.

job.description: The batch job or map reduce used to generate results, if any.

jobId.description: The jobId for the current job. It is used as a foreing key on {@link DataValidationMapReduceJob} or {@link DataValidationBatchJob}.

jobError.description: The error message, if the run failed.

validationStatus.description: The status of the {@link DataValidationRuleset} rules ouput.

title:
A point-in-time execution of a set of {@link DataValidationRule}s. Enables grouping of validation results into distinct "runs".
Created by a call to {@link DataValidationRuleset#validate} when processing its group of {@link DataValidationRule}s.
The {@link DataValidationRun#validationStatus} of the executed rules are linked to this run for future reference.
name: DataValidationRun
